 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sourendra Pandey
 Oral Order
2 04-02-2026 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. Petitioners apprehend their arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 887 of 2023 registered for the offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120(B), 323 and 504 of the I.P.C.
3.

As per the prosecution case, the allegation against the petitioners is that they have got a forged sale deed in their favour and on the basis of the same, a jamabandi has been created in their favour.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.6368 of 2026(2) dt.04-02-2026 petitioners have falsely been implicated in the present case and that the learned court below has taken cognizance without properly appreciating the facts of the case.
It has been submitted that the petitioners are the valid purchasers of the said land and on the basis of the said said deed, jamabandi has been created in their favour.

It has next been submitted that if at all,
the complainant had any problem with regard to the same, he could have filed a civil suit before the competent court.
It has further been submitted that the petitioners have one criminal antecedent in which they have been acquitted.

sentences.text: In view of the above, issue notice to the opposite party no.2 through ordinary post as well as registered cover with A/D for which requisites etc. must be filed within one week, failing which the petition shall stand dismissed without further reference to the Bench.

6. List this case on 11.03.2026, or on receipt of service report, whichever is earlier.
7.
Till further orders, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioners in the present case.

(Sourendra Pandey, J) aditya/-
